integrity: The Sylvester-Hadamard incidence Smith form is known prior work and is explicitly credited; the asserted new claim is the paired-context Smith form and its spectrum. Numerical examples are checks, not the proof. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Pure unweighted graph states on the binary symplectic noncommutation graph, for cuts built from a transverse pair of maximal binary isotropic subspaces; arbitrary integer local dimension at least two, but not arbitrary partitions, weights, mixed states or other underlying forms.
title: Paired-Lagrangian Smith forms and composite-qudit entanglement on binary symplectic graphs
